source: ModelOff 2014 Round 1, 'Precise Debt Modeling'; inputs and answers as transcribed in generic_engine/tests/test_benchmark_round1_precise_debt.py

inputs.regular_date: the drawdown's day of the month, each month after it (the month's last day if shorter)
inputs.condition_1: a regular date that is not a business day moves to the next business day, unless that is in a new month
inputs.condition_2: if condition 1 would move it into a new month, the last business day of the month instead
inputs.condition_3: if the drawdown's day is past the month's end, the last business day of the month
inputs.interest: actual days between payment dates (from the drawdown for the first) / 365, on the opening balance
inputs.payment: constant each month, goal-sought so the last payment repays the loan
